cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — standing; a quiet neon-lit self-service laundromat at night with round unlettered machine doors and a row of orange plastic seats — she taps a rhythm softly on a laundry basket while waiting for the spin cycle; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — tears a finished page out of a notebook; an amusement-park parade street lined with spectators — holds her keepsake at chest height; a modern harbour passenger-ferry bow under an overcast sky — she pauses during a ferry crossing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — holds a microphone close to her lips; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — sweeps the stones off a go board with black and white stones into their bowls; a sunny concrete skate park of smooth bowls and ramps — holds a smartphone at chest height; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — perched on a ledge or edge; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a convention photo zone under ring lights — standing; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a neighbourhood café with a counter and window seats — peels the wrapper off an ice pop on a wooden stick
